reason: shadcn's form.tsx (manifest tier third_party) is glue over react-hook-form: Form is FormProvider, FormField a Controller, and every other part reads its ids (React.useId, form.tsx:77) and the field error from client form state (useFormContext/useFormState). Errors only exist after client validation and the ids never match a server render, so there is no comparable oracle DOM and no catalog harness: the component is gated by Minitest and the chadcn--form browser tests instead of G2. The port reproduces what the DOM exposes, the id/aria/data-error contract of useFormField (form.tsx:61-63, 99, 113-119), over a server-side Binding (Plain, Chadcn::Engine::FormBinding). FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription and FormMessage have no Ruby class: a bound Form::Field composes the existing Field, Field::Label, the control, Field::Description and Field::Error and applies the contract to them; their tokens come from those parts.
api: Form: not FormProvider; renders <form> with the binding's action and method, a _method hidden input for put/patch/delete and a CSRF input except on get, and yields itself
FormField (Controller): form.field(attribute: :name) yields a bound Form::Field; there is no render prop or control object

FormItem / FormLabel / FormControl / FormDescription / FormMessage: no Ruby class; rendered by Field, Field::Label, the control, Field::Description and Field::Error with the ids, for, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and data-error form.tsx gives them
FormMessage: the field's errors win over the block (form.tsx:140); several messages render as Field::Error's list
useFormField: no hook; the bound Form::Field answers id, name, form_item_id, form_description_id, form_message_id and error
chadcn--form (house behavior, no tsx counterpart): mirrors HTML5 validity into the same aria/data-error/message markup
structure: no form-item slot: the field root is <div role="group" data-slot="field" data-orientation> (Chadcn::Field) instead of <div data-slot="form-item" class="grid gap-2">
no form-label slot: the label is data-slot="field-label"
no form-control slot: the control keeps its own data-slot (input, textarea, ...)
no form-description slot: the description is data-slot="field-description"
